# Security Policy: MMS Triadic Core Engine v2

## Supported Software Versions
The configuration architectures and core runtime scripts are actively maintained for stability across the following execution environments:

| Version | Supported | Minimum Runtime Constraints |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| v2.x | :white_check_mark: Yes | Python 3.10 / 3.11 / 3.12 (Multi-Version Tested) |
| v1.x | :x: No | Legacy Hardware Deprecated |

## Vulnerability Reporting & Coordinated Disclosure
As a patented hardware configuration architecture, this codebase implements a strict privacy-first reporting mechanism to maintain system integrity. 

1. **Do Not Open Public Issues:** If you discover a vulnerability, structural instruction drift, or execution bottleneck, please do not disclose it via public GitHub issues, discussions, or pull requests.
2. **Secure Communication:** Please report findings directly through private developer communication channels or submit reports encrypted via automated developer profiles.
3. **Response Timelines:** Submissions receive an initial automated acknowledgment within 48 business hours, followed by an impact review pass conducted through your hardware evaluation modules.

## Safe Harbor & Legal Protection
Security research must respect active legal ownership and patent specifications. Investigations conducted strictly within localized sandboxes or single-board hardware simulators that do not disrupt public distribution lines are protected under coordinated disclosure rules.
